messages:
Myra Choi: hey team! Myra here — first day in the office (badgeless no more). I bake sourdough, read too much sci-fi, and make wildly optimistic plant care schedules. desk is by the big fern on 3F. quick q: best lunchtime stroll around the area? also my coffee order is oat latte + 1 espresso shot. excited to join you all! :wave:

Benji Park: welcome Myra!! there's a small park two blocks east that's perfect for a 15-min walk — we usually do a rooftop loop at 12:30 if you wanna join. i'll bring a spare mug for your oat latte :coffee:

Priya Singh: hi Myra!! i'm Priya (product). sandwich cart on 5th is my usual, and the noodle place near reception does a great veggie bowl. love sourdough — we should swap starter tips sometime :heart_eyes:

Talia Bhat: welcome!! plant swap on Friday if you like trading pothos for small succulents :seedling: your fern will get along great with the philodendron near the windowsill

onboarding-bot: onboarding-bot: Hi Myra — your badge is active. Quick checklist: 1) VPN + email setup 2) runthrough with buddy (Benji) 3) fill out benefits form. Reply 'got it' when done or DM @onboarding-bot for help.

Myra Choi: thanks everyone! @Benji i will join the rooftop loop. @Priya — definitely down for starter tips. also curious: anyone have a spare set of tactile switches or a funky keycap? my home keyboard is a little lonely.

Benji Park: i have an extra set of blue switches and a novelty keycap. i'll drop them by your desk after lunch :ok_hand:

Priya Singh: tiny poll: react to this message with your go-to office drink so Myra knows what to expect — :oat: = oat latte, :coffee: = black coffee, :tea: = tea. (feel free to add other reactions)

hr-bot: hr-bot: Welcome package note — a welcome sticker pack and a plant care sheet were left at Myra's desk. Congrats and welcome to Redwood! :tada:

Myra Choi: omg sticker pack!! this is perfect. thanks y'all, see you on the rooftop :) :smile:
